purpose: Check fixture ID alignment for every GW001 competition key in Results and Match Report
sql: SELECT k.competition_key, COALESCE(r.results_rows,0) results_rows, COALESCE(m.report_rows,0) report_rows, COALESCE(x.matched,0) matched_fixture_ids, COALESCE(x.same_key,0) same_key, COALESCE(x.different_key,0) different_key, COALESCE(r.results_rows,0)-COALESCE(x.matched,0) results_without_report, COALESCE(m.report_rows,0)-COALESCE(y.matched,0) reports_without_result FROM (SELECT competition_key FROM `GW001_IMC Results` UNION SELECT competition_key FROM `GW001_IMC Match Report`) k LEFT JOIN (SELECT competition_key,COUNT(*) results_rows FROM `GW001_IMC Results` GROUP BY competition_key) r ON r.competition_key=k.competition_key LEFT JOIN (SELECT competition_key,COUNT(*) report_rows FROM `GW001_IMC Match Report` GROUP BY competition_key) m ON m.competition_key=k.competition_key LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.competition_key,COUNT(m.sm_fixture_id) matched,SUM(CASE WHEN m.sm_fixture_id IS NOT NULL AND m.competition_key=r.competition_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) same_key,SUM(CASE WHEN m.sm_fixture_id IS NOT NULL AND m.competition_key<>r.competition_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) different_key FROM `GW001_IMC Results` r LEFT JOIN `GW001_IMC Match Report` m ON m.sm_fixture_id=r.sm_fixture_id GROUP BY r.competition_key) x ON x.competition_key=k.competition_key LEFT JOIN (SELECT m.competition_key,COUNT(r.sm_fixture_id) matched FROM `GW001_IMC Match Report` m LEFT JOIN `GW001_IMC Results` r ON r.sm_fixture_id=m.sm_fixture_id GROUP BY m.competition_key) y ON y.competition_key=k.competition_key ORDER BY k.competition_key
